needs.premise: Three authority generations, split physical store/log, losing acquisition response, repeated helper exit and GC scan. Real cooperative/platform stop and root completeness are external witnesses; bounded histories are not native proof.
Selective conditional laws for per-generation closure, successor admission, root retention and unknown-result custody. Not complete transition induction/source simulation.
Generate stable VM scope before marker allocation, root procedure first, and funnel SFUN conversions, result and propagation through exact activation cleanup; no untracked raw escape admitted.
Generate effect/borrow scope independently of conversion cleanup selection; close future entry and drain operations at safe exit, including inline and out-of-line conversion/error edges.

call rethrow must carry stable journal to enclosing run/generated catch; restored catcher precedes no-throw close funnel; marker kill and result/root ownership settle separately; nested closure is per activation.

PSTATE cleanup or thread_exit call is not termination; actual successful unique join plus runtime/helper/foreign-borrower census and callback debt settlement is required. Errors/unknown keep VM custody.

Successor requires previous helper generation control/data closure, no delayed operations or writers, exact lease and drained metadata readers; never reuse original owner receipt or replay root/native effects.

Entry gate and in-flight acquisition must be one race-safe protocol; release close receipt follows actual stores, acquire exact generation precedes handoff. Plain field exclusivity and platform stop remain open.

Observed exit, close request, join error or timeout is not quiescence. Actual generated normal/nonlocal exit or verified thread/helper drain produces separate no-future/no-inflight control and data receipts before helper/recycle.

Keep pending root cell safe false; old frozen source view covers GC until canonical root-admission accepts current value. Slot owns initialized scan contract before close; final commit publishes only control after full root/metadata validation.

Claim header atomic encoding and generation limits, release/acquire publication and plain-field exclusion; async owner-death help needs qualified lock-free header or explicit platform stop. Portable mutex fallback admits only covered cooperative exits.
